generation.scope: The locus of quartic curve pairs on a common quadric is irreducible of codimension four in PGL5. On its dense open set the canonical candidate is finite Frobenius and the odd configuration has a unique normal triple octic. Any regular completion of the marked even pair must then be the candidate or its reversal, both excluded. The two-order rigidity lemma applies to arbitrary finite candidates, including nonreduced ones, with a clean odd matrix.
